title: Antibiotics for Dental Pain and Swelling Guideline
use: Antibiotic stewardship for urgent pulpal/periapical pain and intraoral swelling.

title: Acute Dental Pain Management Guideline
use: First-line pharmacologic pain management for toothache and post-extraction pain.

title: 2020 IADT Guidelines for Traumatic Dental Injuries
use: Avulsion, fractures, luxation injuries, and primary dentition trauma.

title: AAE Consensus Conference Recommended Diagnostic Terminology
use: Pulpal and apical diagnostic labels. Terminology is currently under AAE/ESE revision; dataset should record the version used.

title: Management of Dental Patients Taking Anticoagulants or Antiplatelet Drugs, 2nd ed.
use: Bleeding-risk assessment and dental management in patients taking anticoagulants/antiplatelets.

organization: American Heart Association / American College of Cardiology
title: 2021 AHA/ACC/ASE/CHEST/SAEM/SCCT/SCMR Guideline for the Evaluation and Diagnosis of Chest Pain
use: Recognition and urgent evaluation of possible ischemic cardiac pain referred to the jaw or teeth.

organization: American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery Foundation
title: Clinical Practice Guideline (Update): Adult Sinusitis
use: Recognition of rhinosinusitis presenting as maxillary posterior tooth pain; antibiotic decisions belong to the medical pathway.
